notes: DiscoFlate v3.89.0 — 🧩 Templates are actually global now. They were listed as a per-scene gameplay key, so the panel read the LIVE SCENE's copy while the seeding filled the top-level one — shipped defaults were being written somewhere nothing displayed, and a scene carrying an older copy showed only the kinds that existed when it was saved. Bonus Rounds, Broadcasts, Minigames, Rewards and Modes weren't empty, they were absent. A v19 migration merges every scene's library into one shared map (nothing saved is lost) and stops carrying it per scene, so switching scenes no longer switches your templates. 🧹 The layout pass also continues: System commands loses the margin hacks that faked its checkbox alignment, hints move out from between a label and its control, five more rows bottom-align so labels of any height leave their controls in line, and events, polls, competitions and bonus rounds group under headings instead of one crowded row.
